title: Automatic build-time plugin composition foundation
description: Extend the existing signup plugin protocol: validated enabled configuration and dependencies, collision-safe native TypeScript schema/resources, matching frontend components sharing API types, deterministic normal-build preparation, no-plugin parity, minimal proof and authorization tests. Record decisions, review, checks and draft PR; no deployment or CRM implementation.
right_now_summary: The build is adding automatic plugin composition, typed APIs, validation, and tests.
